description: Codex CLI via the registry ACP adapter (@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp; successor of @zed-industries/codex-acp). Subscription access stays in your Codex login; Garuda never reads it.
setup: 1. Install Node.js 20+ and the Codex CLI, then authenticate with ChatGPT login (codex login); Garuda does not pass CODEX_API_KEY or CODEX_HOME to the adapter. 2. Run: npm install -g @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp. 3. Verify: codex-acp --version. Garuda never reads ~/.codex/auth.json.
